answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents, each reviewed by 3 peers drawn by lottery, as a raven watches a sable burrow guarding its haven. Auditors check work logs: genuine agents pass in minutes, forged ones fail on thin history. Each posts a 200-token deposit; a failed audit burns it, so 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 tokens, more than an epoch pays. Honest agents pay one deposit and keep their share undiluted.
